description: Good decision: mail/main.rs uses a graduated response for the ActivityPub HTTP-signature-disabled case. On a loopback address it logs a warn (acceptable for local dev). On a non-loopback address it exits with an error. This avoids breaking local development workflows while still preventing the misconfiguration from reaching production. The same pattern could have been a hard error in both cases (too strict) or a warning in both cases (not strict enough); the loopback distinction is the right split.
title: DECISION: graduated warn vs error for loopback violations
